This app contains only the fan-made game engine. It needs the data files of your own copy of Airline Tycoon Deluxe (GOG or Steam).

1. On your computer, pack the game folder into a ZIP file.
2. Copy the ZIP to this device.
3. Select it below. About 400 MB of free space are required.
This ZIP does not contain the game files (folders gli, room, misc, data are missing).
The app storage is not available.
Alternative: copy the game folders with a computer to\n%1$s
